remaining_architecture_gaps: four_paths: Declared candidate now combines live wired CDR/idle/supply kicks, wideband modulated RF/multipole filtering/blockers/phase events, both converter pipelines, shared reference loads and host pauses. Four signed both-mode cases pass transport and provisional RF quality. Missing intended functions elsewhere in this inventory and broader uncertainty/independent-source operation still prevent whole-chip closure.

sustained_rate_ownership: Common-reference rates and selected visibility/phase tests pass;16/64-word H2D pauses pass and256-word pauses fault. Still establish variable CDC, arbitrary service-phase and finite queue bounds across lock transients.

clock_services: RF LO events and opt-in live wired RX CDR now affect pending decisions causally. Still represent wired TX oscillator ownership, autonomous RF acquisition, noise spectra and supply-to-clock response; seeded RF phase trajectories remain sensitivity fixtures.

rf_chain: Independent externally modulated RF reception now runs with live wired traffic and both converter delays; TX data/LO changes leave uncoupled RX unchanged, RX LO changes affect capture. Extend combined-profile uncertainty and signal-quality measurements to this independent source, including source/sample frequency offsets. RF gain, images/leakage and overload remain open; previous phase-budget results remain conditional.

converters_reference: Finite converter pipelines, shared/separate reference loads and signed ADC clipping diagnostics are integrated. Saturated codes retain validity; nonfinite inputs are rejected. Hardware diagnostic mapping, overload recovery, DAC analog limits and full reference/source-sink/noise operating envelopes remain open.

wired_modes: Bit TX and live RX now include swing/shaping, timed RX equalizer boosts and retained channel/equalizer charge and bandwidth through compatible retraining/mode changes. Autonomous TX clock, equalizer adaptation/calibration, receiver-detect impedance and automatic slip reporting remain open.

programmable_resources: Memory, finite management operation, filters, receive routing/gain and named diagnostics are connected. Full resource graph/capability map, actual trim-to-analog mapping/calibration and full asynchronous reset remain open. Packed status ABI and SPI/CDC not fully modeled.

management_lifecycle: Timed transactions now configure resources, start finite32-sample local TX/RX atomically, report capture completion and recover epochs. Continuous streaming/run-stop and trigger controls, LO/trim/calibration and hardware multiword SPI/CDC mapping remain open.

coexistence: Signed combined profile now passes four-path transport and RF screening with live wired switching response, converter delays and shared reference loads. Continuous supply-to-frequency response, RF LO/wired TX coupling, package/domain network assumptions and broader uncertainty remain open.

coverage_and_reproducibility: Fresh full suite plus source-linked matrix covering both throughput modes, lower-rate/capture operation, negative controls and uncertainty endpoints. Declare scenario limits.
